scope: Functional McKernel OS/apps and Rust/assembly migration only; no security testing.
accepted_design_boundaries: Existing watcher and CreditBudget are reused; no canonical launcher rewrite.
Current healthy LONG and resident model are left untouched while the bridge waits.
Only exact included_usage_guard plus real weekly exhaustion or a current exact-final-state handoff permit can authorize prepaid transition.
New model may first reconcile preserved native ownership; new guests/builds still require normal actual clearance.
Legacy worker-only expiry uses PIDfd with birth/PPID checks; ordinary finite-watcher drain is not deliberately signaled twice.

bounded_corrections.finding: After credit launch the bridge delegates expiry to a relative monotonic watcher even if wall UTC jumps forward to the absolute deadline. A forward-then-backward correction may produce HOLD_CLOCK_REGRESSION and exit the only guardian for a legacy hours0 worker. Other transition/source HOLD exits have the same deadline-supervision problem.
bounded_corrections.required: Persist the earliest effective cutoff across forward/backward changes and rearm; suppress new launches on HOLD while retaining deadline supervision. Expiry/user cancellation must still cause at most one exact-worker normal drain, with fresh already-draining checks and no watcher/group/server/guest signal.

bounded_corrections.finding: SOURCE-READY source pins are recorded but not enforced at arm/delayed spawn/adapter entry; startup-instruction digest is recomputed from potentially changed bytes.
bounded_corrections.required: Enforce the frozen private/canonical packet identities at actual execution boundaries, use the frozen current startup digest, and refuse inference/relaunch on drift while retaining deadline supervision.

bounded_corrections.finding: Replacement watcher is a direct child but is never polled/joined. It may remain a same-birth zombie indefinitely, preventing positive retirement and normal bridge termination.
bounded_corrections.required: Poll/reap the owned child, preserve actual exit/join identity and keep process-group/lease reconciliation distinct. Add a mock lifecycle case. Author independently identified this same issue.

bounded_corrections.finding: Negative exit with retained launcher_error/retryable or prior recoverable metadata can still pass the wrapper; current tests cover only a negative exit with empty reason.
bounded_corrections.required: Reject generic negative-exit fallback; retain only any explicitly justified existing positive watchdog classification. Add negative-exit/stale-metadata mocks.

next_check: After one coherent revised source freeze, root grants one offline mocked regression job covering actual loop/admission/drain/child ownership boundaries, not only pure decision examples. No production arming before source acceptance and actual tests.
